description: A Windows desktop showing a split-screen with DataGrip (database IDE) on the left displaying SQL queries against a table, and a Microsoft Edge browser on the right showing a Notion page titled "Quick handoff pack you can zip and send" with instructions about session handoffs.

The screen shows a split view with VS Code on the left displaying SQL code (a SELECT query with table joins) and a browser on the right showing what appears to be a Claude AI chat interface with documentation about "What NOT to do next time" and a "Quick handoff pack" section.

A user is working with a split-screen setup showing SQL code in VS Code on the left (with a query selecting from a table) and a Notion document on the right displaying a "Handoff Pack" section with instructions and checklist items.

A Windows desktop showing three applications: a SQL code editor with a query selecting table metadata on the left, a wiki/documentation page about "Sessions Legal" with a handoff checklist in the center browser, and what appears to be a VS Code or similar dark-themed IDE on the right side.

A database query editor (appears to be DBeaver) is open showing a SQL query that filters for sample and Balwatex tables, with query results displayed below highlighting rows in yellow containing table names like `dws_pos_txn_panel_mstr_dly_srt_ss` and related sample data tables.
